    Homogeneous module and arrow lifts (Proposition 7.6, weights) #

    weights-and-parameters.tex: "Lift a basis of the integer ray weights to mesh weights using Lemma 7.4. These give simultaneous gradings on the lifted modules. If μ has character χ, give ε weight −χ and choose the homogeneous solutions in the lemma. Then z_v has weight χ relative to its row."

    The homogeneous solutions are obtained from arbitrary ones by taking weight parts: the lifted action equations and the arrow-lifting equations are linear, and all fixed maps in them shift weights, so the weight-χ parts of the corrections are again solutions (wLift, wLiftData). Their mesh errors shift by ν_x + χ (zE_wshift), hence lie in C(τx, x) of weight ν_x + χ (exists_liftData_wt).
